description: The SV → BTOR2 lift inputs shared by the SV-direct verb endpoints (`/api/v1/sv/verify`, `/sv/verify-liveness`, `/sv/verify-recoverability`). These lift the module (sv2v + Yosys) and then decide the corresponding BTOR2 property, returning the same `Btor2Verify*Response` shapes — one call, no `emit-btor2` step.

merge_clock_domains.description: Lift a multi-clock design onto the model's one implicit clock instead of refusing it. An UNDER-approximation: the domains only ever tick together, so a HOLDS does not transfer (the `clock-domains-merged` soundness caveat). Default `false` (refused at lift time).

top.description: Top module for the lift (auto-detect when omitted).

use_slang.description: Force the slang RTL front-end (`read_slang`) for modern-SV constructs yosys/sv2v reject (`while` loops, `import pkg::*;`). Requires the yosys-slang plugin. Default `false`.

use_sv2v.description: Run sv2v before Yosys (modern SV). Default `false`.
